text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I invite Trainer Kiryuin out to the park
for a day
of rest and relaxation...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
It's been a while since I've come to the
park for
reasons outside of work!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...I played at the park by myself a lot
when I was
young.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
D-don't get me wrong, I had friends! But
I also
liked to play alone.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: For instance, I used to gaze up at the sky while I was on top of the jungle gym and read Twinkle Monthly...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Or I would sit on the swing and read the
Trainer's
Handbook...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: You know, fun stuff like that!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's not all I did! Since you're so
curious, I
also enjoyed the rest of the
playground too!
choice_data_list_en: Aren't both of those just reading?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
The seesaw, the horizontal bar, and so
on...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. As an adult, I couldn't recommend
this to
children, but...
choice_data_list: 鉄棒、得意な技があったり？
choice_data_list_en: On the seesaw... all by yourself...?
Do you have a favorite trick on the horizontal bar?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I would stand on one the end of the
seesaw and
then walk over to the other
end. That really
helped me with my
balance!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
The trick is to start lowering your stance
once you
cross to the opposite side.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
If you want to improve your sense of
balance,
doing that over and over with
the right posture is
the way to go.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know! I'll just show you. Watch!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
So, you avoid the seat, then extend your
spine
nice and straight...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
See? This is the point where it's easy to
lose your
balance, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kiryuin extends both of her hands out to
keep her
balance. She looks quite proud
as she crosses the
seesaw.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Not bad, right? My friends always tell
me that I've
got good balance. I'm very
confident in it...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Ah, s-sorry. I'm rambling now, aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, go for it! I'll be right beside you,
so don't
worry!
choice_data_list_en: I'll give it a shot, too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After making sure there are no children
around to
see, I play on the seesaw with
Trainer Kiryuin.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, especially pull-ups!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
The trick is to use your strength to
gradually get
used to doing it, rather
than trying to do it all at
once.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
For starters, just do ten... or even just
five.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Results may be the most important thing
at the
end of the day, but that doesn't
mean you should
ignore the process.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
You'll only find your way to good results
if you
have a solid base of hard work!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Gasp!
choice_data_list: それは遊びではなくトレーニングでは？
choice_data_list_en: Isn't that training rather than playing around?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I-if that's the case, then maybe I actually
haven't
played at the park before...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A look of shock comes over Trainer
Kiryuin's face
as she realizes this, so I
invite her to play on the
swings with me.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't really do anything at first, but
I got
more and more used to it until I
could do a
hundred!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, I haven't done any
pull-ups
at all lately. Do you mind if I try
now?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I cheer Trainer Kiryuin on as she does
pull-ups
with a fiercely determined
expression.
